# Dart dynamic API sources

These headers and `dart_api_dl.c` were copied from the repository's existing
`example/dart_api/zig/include` snapshot. They retain the Dart project's copyright
notices. `LICENSE` contains the Dart SDK BSD license.

They are vendored here so this example can become an independent repository
without relying on a sibling example. Update the headers, internal header,
version header, and C implementation together from one Dart SDK snapshot.
